title: Continuation procedure: reconcile first, then extend
summary: Before modifying Wire UI runtime components, resolve exact package/version/hash state across the current roll-up and separately supplied candidates, run the relevant existing suites, and merge cross-chat branches instead of choosing by version name.
invariants: Never code from remembered architecture when the exact package can be recovered.
Never let a newer roll-up silently erase a separately qualified increment that it has not incorporated.
Version-name collisions are resolved by source/hash comparison and additive reconciliation, not last-writer-wins.
Keep browser, gateway, server, Builder, Swing and Resource Authority ownership boundaries intact while merging.
Do not move business/application semantics into Node/static HTTP/gateway code to make a demo work.
procedure: Inventory the newest ooRexx API roll-up and separately supplied candidate ZIPs.
Hash and inspect exact component packages; identify true successors versus parallel branches.
Run component suites against the exact dependency combination before promotion.
Exercise one real cross-language Queue Fabric/browser path for protocol changes.
For resource changes, prove exact ResourceRef survives Builder -> Server -> Queue Fabric -> renderer resolver.
For network-delivery changes, prove source and optimised modes use the same application/queue semantics.
Update this sphere's baseline/provenance only after the qualified candidate exists.
